WMA Lossless cannot be encoded here. The FFmpeg this build links carries wmav1 and wmav2 as its only WMA encoders (measured: `ffmpeg -encoders`), and Windows ships no WMA lossless ACM codec either, so every encoder reachable from here is a downgrade from lossless. What keeps a WMA Lossless track intact is the switch above: the bytes go over untouched instead of being converted. FLAC, WAV and APE have no lossless destination on a Zune at all, so syncing one is always a lossy convert to the format chosen above. ~=> 这里无法编码 WMA Lossless。本版本链接的 FFmpeg 只带有 wmav1 与 wmav2 两个 WMA 编码器（实测：`ffmpeg -encoders`），Windows 也未提供 WMA 无损的 ACM 编解码器，因此从这里能选到的每一个编码器相对于无损都是降级。让 WMA Lossless 保持完整的办法是上面那个开关：字节原样传输，而不是转换。FLAC、WAV 与 APE 在 Zune 上根本不存在无损去处，因此同步它们时必然是有损转换为上面所选的格式。

Bit rate is constant only. A variable-bitrate MP3 header is not written by this build - measured, the LAME/Xing frame is absent and the player then reports a track three minutes shorter than it is - so VBR is not offered. ~=> 码率只能是恒定的。本版本不会写入可变码率的 MP3 头 —— 实测缺少 LAME/Xing 帧，播放器随后会把曲目时长少报三分钟 —— 因此不提供 VBR。
